title: gólya, hátizsák: Packing for the Countryside

sections.title: Packing and planning
sections.content: *hátizsák* ("backpack") and *gólya* ("stork") are the two new words. You know *összepakol* and *tesz* from Units 39 and 6, *holnap* and the *-ba/-be* ending from A1, and *fog* + infinitive for plans from Unit 27. With them you can pack a bag and say what you will do on the trip.

sections.title: A bag and a plan
rows: I put water in the backpack.
We will hike in the forest.

items.english: Tomorrow I will pack the backpack.

items.spanish: A hátizsákba vizet, kenyeret és sajtot teszek.
items.english: I put water, bread and cheese in the backpack.
On Sunday we will hike in the forest.
In the village we can see many storks.

sections.content: In Hungarian villages you often see *gólyák* nesting on chimneys or poles. Note the word order of the plan: with the place in focus right before *fog*, the infinitive follows it: *az erdőben fogunk túrázni*.
